verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to view observability spend, attribute it to teams or services, or alert on usage spikes before billing. Adaptive Telemetry is described only as reducing telemetry costs by aggregating data, which is adjacent cost optimization rather than spend visibility. The 'cost management' item covers LLM usage in AI Observability, a different subject, and general alerting is a building block, not a spend-tracking capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
